_readme: The lines a tool logs as consensus facts land, the text block it returns beside its structured
result, and narrate()'s sentences over an EvidenceBundle all come from this file. Same sentence,
three readers. goose renders tool-call cards and final payloads and does NOT render
notifications/progress, so the process log is the live surface and the result's text block is the
retrospective one; a reader who saw only one of them must not learn a different fact from it.
NONE OF THESE MAY IMPLY RECEIPT OR DELIVERY. §2.3 reserves *delivery* for the lane — an envelope
is delivered when its chunks reach the lane, and nothing about a recipient having read it is ever
claimed — and §11.8 forbids turning silence into refusal. So a sentence here says where a fact
landed and what it was; it never says that anyone received, read, accepted or refused anything.
The word 'delivered' appears nowhere below by design, and 'posted' is what a chunk on a lane is.
Placeholders are {name} and every one of them must be supplied: `line()` throws on a missing key,
so a template and its caller cannot drift into a sentence with a hole in it.
provision.already: {account} already has coordinates on consensus; its doorbell is {doorbell}. Nothing to create.
provision.existing: {role} is already {id}, and its shape on consensus is the one it was created under.
provision.associated: {account} associated with {token}, so it can hold the stamp a doorbell's fee is taken from.
provision.profile: profile written to {topic} in {chunks} chunk(s); its plaintext hashes to {digest}.
provision.registered: registered on {registry} at sequence {sequenceNumber}, naming file topic {fileTopic}.
provision.memo: {account}'s memo now reads {memo}, which is where a resolver starts.
provision.resolved: {account} resolves under hcs14 at trust class {trustClass} with {endorsements} endorsement(s).
purchase.quoted: the counter quoted {count} stamp(s) at {price} {currency}{provisioning}, reference {reference}.
purchase.signed: the purchase body was signed in this process; the counter never held a key of this agent's.
purchase.settled: the purchase settled as {txRef} at {consensusTimestamp}; the holder is {holder}.
purchase.account: the transfer created account {account}, owned by this agent's key.
register.existing: {account} is already registered on the anchor {anchor}; nothing was submitted.
register.submitted: registered on the anchor {anchor} at sequence {sequenceNumber}, paid by {payer}.
send.lane.found: lane {lane} found; it was created at {createdAt} and is the earliest open one between these two.
send.ringing: ringing the doorbell {doorbell}; one stamp goes to the treasury for the request.
send.request: the connection request is at sequence {sequenceNumber} on {doorbell}, at {consensusTimestamp}.
send.lane.created: lane {lane} created, its submit key a threshold of exactly the two agents' keys.
send.affixed: postage affixed at {txRef} under the memo {memo}, which names this envelope and no other.
send.chunk: chunk {index} of {total} postmarked on {lane} at sequence {sequenceNumber}.
send.settled: every chunk has a consensus timestamp; the first is {consensusTimestamp}.
send.slip: the window of {window}s closed with no answer on {doorbell}. Expiry is not silence, and nothing is claimed about the recipient.
narrative.scope: This reading covers {topics} topic(s) on {ledgerTags}, from consensus timestamp {from} to {to}, under specification {spec}.
narrative.empty: No envelope was found in that scope.
narrative.posted: It was posted to lane {lane} in {chunks} chunk(s), the first postmarked at {consensusTimestamp} as sequence {sequenceNumber}.
narrative.postage: Its postage was {amount} stamp(s) in token {tokenId}, affixed by {from} to {to} at {consensusTimestamp} under the memo {memo}, which names this envelope and no other.
narrative.postage.absent: No settlement was found at the reference its header names.
narrative.resolution: Its resolution was made under the {profile} profile, declared at trust class {trustClass} {endorsements}, and its manifest is message {sequenceNumber} on topic {topicId}.
narrative.seal: It was sealed against key epoch {keyEpoch}, over {ciphertextBytes} bytes of ciphertext, weighing {weight} ounce(s).
narrative.verified: Every check this reading ran held, so its standing is verified.
narrative.standing: Its standing is {standing}, which is the lowest any check yielded, and the checks that yielded it are {reasons}.
narrative.receipt.none: No return receipt was requested for it, and none was found.
narrative.offchain: {count} chunk(s) bearing this identifier reached consensus off the chain and were recorded without being used.
narrative.silence: This reading says nothing about what the envelope contained; nothing on any topic can.
narrative.orphans: {count} settlement(s) named no envelope in this scope.
